From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Owen <sam.owen@datwell.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: DataWell: technical onramp — VPC / on-prem deep-dive scheduling

Hi Sam —

Great to meet you on the intro call last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to run a focused technical onramp to cover VPC connectivity, networking design (bastion/NAT), and IAM roles for Redwood Private deployment. Goal: get your engineering and security teams comfortable with prerequisites so we can surface any blockers before procurement.

Who should join from your side (network, security, procurement)? We propose a 90-minute deep-dive and a separate 30-minute procurement alignment meeting if needed. Available windows from our side:
- Thu 11/20 09:00–11:00 PT
- Thu 11/20 13:00–15:00 PT
- Fri 11/21 08:30–10:00 PT

Stephanie (SE) and Neha (security) are cc'd and will lead the technical agenda. Ben (sales ops) will help with calendar/procurement logistics.

Attached: redwood-deepdive-agenda.pdf (draft). I can also share a short questionnaire to collect CIDRs, expected egress, and sample IAM roles prior to the session.

Next step: confirm preferred window and attendee list and we’ll send invites.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DataWell: technical onramp — VPC / on-prem deep-dive scheduling

Thanks Karthik —

We can do a technical session. Attendees from our side: Jessica Li (network), Marco Ruiz (security lead), and I’ll invite procurement on a separate invite — procurement@datwell.com is copied.

Of the times you proposed, Thu 11/20 13:00–14:30 PT looks promising for the engineers; though Jessica asked if we could keep it to 60–75 minutes. Procurement prefers a later single 30-minute sync next week (they have internal approvals).

Can you share the agenda and any pre-reads (CIDR template, example IAM mapping)? Also looping in Jessica so she can confirm network-specific items.

—Sam
Sam Owen
Lead, Platform Engineering | DataWell Analytics

Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 10:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DataWell: technical onramp — VPC / on-prem deep-dive scheduling

Got it — thanks Sam.

We can do Thu 11/20 13:00–14:15 PT and will aim to keep it tight (60–75 minutes). I’ve attached the draft agenda and a quick CIDR/IAM questionnaire (DataWell_VPC_Questions.xlsx).

Proposed agenda (high level):
1) 5m — introductions & goals
2) 20m — architecture walkthrough (your network + target Redwood topology)
3) 25m — connectivity options: VPN vs Direct Connect, NAT/bastion patterns, egress considerations
4) 15m — IAM/service account patterns, audit/logging (what we require and what’s optional)
5) 10m — open questions & next steps

If that looks good, we’ll send a calendar invite (separate procurement invite for their 30-minute sync). Please confirm the attendee list we should include on the technical invite.

I attached: redwood-deepdive-agenda.pdf; DataWell_VPC_Questions.xlsx; will send calendar invite once you confirm.

Thanks,
Karthik

Hi Sam / Karthik —

Thanks for the details — quick tech notes ahead of Thu: please try to collect the following before the deep-dive so we can make the session productive:
- A simple network diagram (current VPC/subnets; CIDR ranges)
- Public egress requirements and any IP allowlists you’ll need for external services
- Any traffic inspection/mirroring appliances in path (we’ll need to understand MTU and potential proxies)
- Example IAM roles/service accounts that will own model inference tasks (we’ll show the minimal permission set)

If you have an SSH bastion, please note how it’s configured (jump host user, key-based auth, or SSO). Otherwise we’ll discuss secure alternatives.

I added a short Confluence doc with our recommended patterns: https://redwoodinference.app/confluence/SE/VPC-OnPrem-Patterns

—Steph
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
